description: Weak position: Procedural compliance but challenging facts

input.problem_statement: Client charged with embezzlement from employer. Clear paper trail shows unauthorized transfers to client's account totaling 500,000 HRK. Client claims it was bonus owed but no documentation. Employer has detailed records.

procedural_steps: explore civil settlement to show good faith
argument_titles: Dispute over compensation not criminal intent (weak)
Client willing to make full restitution
Civil matter more appropriate than criminal

validation_notes: Should generate 2-3 weak arguments (avg 22-40), strongly recommend plea with restitution, low success probability 12-28%, focus on civil vs criminal nature and restitution, practical damage control strategy.
